The '''Perlemian Trade Route-Cholganna hyperlane''' was a poorly-known [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that ran from the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] to [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
